belongs_to: 'Express the number 32400 as a product of its prime factors and represent the prime factors in their exponential form.' (division ladder printed at the right of the example)
description: Repeated-division (prime factorisation) ladder drawn as a descending staircase; each row is 'divisor | number' with a vertical bar after the divisor and a horizontal line under the number, and each next row is indented one step to the right. Rows top to bottom (divisor | number): 2 | 32400; 2 | 16200; 2 | 8100; 2 | 4050; 5 | 2025; 5 | 405; 3 | 81; 3 | 27; 3 | 9; 3 | 3; then a final '1' under the last line. 10 divisors in total: 2, 2, 2, 2, 5, 5, 3, 3, 3, 3 (four 2s, two 5s, four 3s). Text beside it: 32400 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 5 × 5 × 3 × 3 × 3 × 3 = 2⁴ × 5² × 3⁴.

belongs_to: 'The Stones that Shine ...' - 'How many rooms were there altogether? The information given can be visualised as shown below.'
description: Tree diagram, branching factor 3 at every level, in three coloured panels (pale green background) side by side, one per daughter. Top: label 'King' above a short vertical line that drops to a horizontal bar; three lines go down from the bar, one to each daughter. Level 1 'daughters': 3 daughters, each a face in a round coloured frame (left blue, middle pink, right green). Level 2 'baskets': 3 baskets under each daughter (9 baskets in all), joined by a horizontal line in the daughter's colour (blue / pink / green). Level 3 'keys': 3 keys under each basket (9 keys per daughter, 27 keys in all), joined by a short horizontal bar in the same colour. Level 4 'rooms': each key has a line down to one 3-pronged fork-like icon (27 icons, 9 per colour group); each icon stands for 3 rooms, so 27 x 3 = 81 = 3⁴ rooms. Right-hand labels with curved black arrows: 'daughters' (pointing to a daughter), 'baskets', 'keys', 'rooms' (pointing at the last two basket/key/room levels of the right panel). Printed text under it: the number of rooms is 3⁴; 3×3=9, 9×3=27, 27×3=81, 81×3=243; diamonds = 3⁷.
unclear: Whether each 3-pronged icon is meant as one room or as three rooms is not printed; the text says rooms = 3⁴ = 81, which matches 27 icons x 3 prongs.

belongs_to: 'To find 3⁷, we can just multiply 3⁴ (= 81) with 3³ (= 27).' (grouping picture at the right of '= 3⁴ × 3³')
description: A row of seven 3s with multiplication signs: '3 × 3 × 3 × 3 × 3 × 3 × 3'. Below the row two under-braces: the first brace spans the first four 3s and is labelled '3⁴'; the second brace spans the last three 3s and is labelled '3³'. The multiplication sign between the 4th and 5th 3 sits between the two braces. 7 threes = 4 + 3.

belongs_to: 'Power Lines - Let us arrange the powers of 4 along a line.' (also used by 'Can we say that 16384 (4⁷) is 16 (4²) times larger than 1,024 (4⁵)?' and 'How many times larger than 4⁻² is 4²?')
description: Vertical number line (power line): one long vertical axis with 11 equally spaced horizontal ticks. Left of the ticks the exponent form, right of the ticks the value, top to bottom: 4⁸ = 65536; 4⁷ = 16384; 4⁶ = 4096; 4⁵ = 1024; 4⁴ = 256; 4³ = 64; 4² = 16; 4¹ = 4; 4⁰ = 1; 4⁻¹ = 1/4 (stacked fraction); 4⁻² = 1/16 (stacked fraction). Four curved arrows: (a) on the left, from 4⁸ down to 4⁷, labelled '÷ 4'; (b) on the right, from 4096 (tail) up to 65536 (arrowhead), labelled '× 16' (spanning the 4096 and 16384 rows); (c) on the left lower part, from 4³ down to 4¹ (arrowhead at 4¹), labelled '÷ 16'; (d) on the right lower part, from 4 (tail) up to 16 (arrowhead), labelled '× 4'. Left bracket: three horizontal lines labelled '4⁸ ÷ 4³', '4³ × 4²', '4⁷ × 4⁻²' (top, middle, bottom, on the rows of 4⁶, 4⁵, 4⁴) merge with angled elbows into one line that ends at the 4⁵ row. Right bracket: three horizontal lines labelled '65536 ÷ 64', '64 × 16', '16384 × 1/16' (the last with a stacked fraction 1/16) merge with angled elbows into one line that ends at the 1024 row. So all six expressions equal 4⁵ = 1024.
unclear: Exact start/end rows of the curved arrows are read from the picture: the left top arrow runs from the 4^8 row to the 4^7 row; the right top arrow starts at about the 4096 row and ends at the 65536 row.
